en_us: The trains, the anvil with no level limit and the trades with no Mending are now in the mods Railhold, Runehold and Markethold. The modpack has these three mods. A world keeps its trains and its minecarts.
fr_fr: Les trains, l'enclume sans limite de niveau et les échanges sans Raccommodage sont maintenant dans les mods Railhold, Runehold et Markethold. Le modpack contient ces trois mods. Un monde garde ses trains et ses wagonnets.
